PhysVal-06 reviewed **`58f49b9ce12f24f7e11b1b7a3f85fa48fbad020f`**, read-only. **No material source findings.**

The separate control genuinely supplies Gaussian **pitch/√12** widths to all measured coordinates, preserves one-dimensional long strips, disables merging, retains all generated events and audits stored measurement variances. Analysis requires four completed 5,000-event cases at 100 GeV and supports deterministic paired-bootstrap replay.

**Three exact-pinned control tests passed**; supplied source SHA-256 identities matched. No files changed.

Keep the boundary qualification: native Gaussian draws undergo retries and possible rejection near sensor edges. Retain loss counts and standardized-residual diagnostics.

I independently reproduced the digital pilot’s fine-coordinate covariance coupling: reconstructed u stays identical, while mean u variance increases as v pitch grows. That demonstrates coupling, without establishing its complete contribution to the high-pT effect.

Final retained control results remain for the next evidence review.
